USER CONSTRAINT: Must limit annual power loss below 0.5% over 25 years at 1000V system bias without encapsulant replacement
CALCULATED: Sodium ion blocking efficiency >99.9% required to limit Na+ migration to <0.002% of cover glass content annually
ASSUMPTION: Standard cover glass contains ~0.2% sodium by weight

THRESHOLD: Less than 0.01% relative power degradation after 1000 hours at 85°C/85%RH/1000V bias
USER CONSTRAINT: 25-year lifetime requirement necessitates accelerated testing protocol
CALCULATED: 1000 hours at 85°C/85%RH/1000V equivalent to approximately 25 years at field conditions per Arrhenius acceleration model
ASSUMPTION: Activation energy for Na+ diffusion is 0.8 eV

FALSIFICATION TEST: Comparative power degradation measurement between modules with and without barrier layer after 2000 hours at 90°C/90%RH/1200V bias
USER CONSTRAINT: Must demonstrate statistical significance (p<0.05) in mitigation effectiveness
CALCULATED: Sample size of 20 modules per test group required for 95% confidence level
ASSUMPTION: Normal distribution of degradation rates with 10% standard deviation
